- For the expected peak of 12M/week, the unit economics will depend on model mix and whether you leverage our KV caching and smaller sequence lengths for retrieval-heavy prompts. Ballpark pricing (hosted API, standard models + caching): $10-$14 per 1M tokens; for larger models or disabled cache that can drift upward.

On credits: I can approve a 30-day extension of the pilot credits (same terms) — I'll need a quick sign-off from our finance ops team and will share the formal approval PDF. Can you confirm the exact extension window you need (start/end dates) and whether you'd like us to cap the extra credits at a specific token allotment?

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm extension window + any cap by EOD Thu.
2) If you expect the 12M/week peak, let's schedule a short infra checklist call (20 min) to walk through batching and caching settings — available Thu afternoon or Fri morning.
3) We'll provision the credits and share the DocuSign/approval link and updated mutual action plan.

Looping Rachel from Finance Ops to expedite the approval.
